Currently, running `fiftyone config`, which simply loads and prints one's FO config, takes ~2 seconds to execute on my machine, because `import fiftyone` currently triggers a DB service to be started, among other things. Can we adopt a lazy initialization strategy where the DB service is only started when absolutely necessary? The main culprits seem to be: - submodules in fiftyone reference back to the public api which means importing submodules imports everything.
